title: Config changes
bottom_line: One setting was reversed and one pair of settings now conflicts.

items.title: Retry on 503
items.after: A request that returns 503 is retried twice.

items.title: Sessions no longer expire on idle
items.before: A session ends after 15 idle minutes.
items.after: A session lasts until the user signs out.

items.title: Session limit contradicts the audit rule
items.after: Every session must end within 12 hours.
